subject: MPA: acceptance lane decision playbook — SOC 2 / SIG / DPA questions
messages:
From: Ethan Ross <ethan.ross@ledgerpath.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 10 May 2026 09:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Mutual Action Plan — security clarifications & timeline

Hi Mina / Ben,

Thanks for the demo last week — LedgerPath is lining up an internal review for the POC and procurement team. Before we lock dates I need a few clarifications so we can feed them into our MAP and legal review: 

- SOC 2: can you confirm whether Redwood's current attestation covers the hosted API and Dedicated nodes (we will be testing hosted but evaluating dedicated for production)? Which trust services are in scope (Security / Availability / Confidentiality)?
- SIG/CAIQ: do you have a current self-assessment we can review? If not, what is the expected cadence to provide one?
- DPA / Data retention: attached is our draft redline (short comments inline). We need to know where Redwood expects data residency to be enforced (hosted default vs Dedicated/VPC) and your standard retention buckets for customer PII and telemetry (30 / 90 / 365 day buckets?).
- KMS/HSM: any note on support for customer-managed keys and escrow/rotation policies?

We'd like to propose a MAP that pins an evidence intake date, SOC 2 confirmation, DPA execution, and a limited production-acceptance window (canary). Can you share a quick MAP timeline and the specific evidence items we should prepare?

Attaching: Draft_DPA_Redline.docx (comments inline)

Best,
Ethan Ross
Director, Platform & Security
LedgerPath
[Attachment: Draft_DPA_Redline.docx (18 KB)]

From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
To: Ethan Ross <ethan.ross@ledgerpath.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 11 May 2026 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Mutual Action Plan — security clarifications & timeline

Ethan — thanks for the clear list. Quick answers and a suggested MAP draft attached. High level: 

- SOC 2: Redwood's latest Type II covers hosted API (control plane & multitenant inference) and our Dedicated offering under a separate scoped attestation. I will confirm the PDF attestation we can share (expect a common cover that shows Hosted + Dedicated variances). In-scope trust services: Security + Availability. Confidentiality controls are implemented (encryption, access controls) but are not called out as a separate trust service in the current report; we can map controls to your requirements.

- SIG/CAIQ: we maintain a current self-assessment; I can push the CAIQ export to you by EOD tomorrow.

- DPA & retention: we usually support configurable retention windows. Default telemetry retention is 90 days; PII retention (customer-controlled) defaults to 365 days unless contract carves out shorter buckets. For EU residency we offer a VPC-hosted option or a managed regional hosting. The attached MAP_timeline_v1.xlsx shows a 6-week intake -> canary -> handoff cadence (draft).

- KMS/HSM: Customer-managed keys are supported in VPC and Dedicated via KMS integrations (AWS KMS, GCP KMS) and we offer an HSM-backed escrow option for enterprise. We'll include a KMS capability summary.

Proposed near-term MAP milestones (from the spreadsheet):
  1) Evidence intake & SIG template share — target: 2026-05-21
  2) SOC 2 attestation share + DPA redline response — target: 2026-05-28
  3) Legal sign & DPA execution — target: 2026-06-04
  4) Canary (limited traffic + monitoring) — 2026-06-15 to 2026-06-22
  5) Full production handoff / SLA start — target: 2026-06-29

Can you confirm those target dates and whether the EU residency requirement is a hard gating item for go/no-go? Also confirm who on your side will own evidence submission (SRE / Legal / Procurement).

I attached the current MAP timeline and a short action item PDF. If that looks good I'll loop in Legal for the DPA redline discussion and open a drive folder for evidence collection.

Thanks,

Mina Haddad
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: MAP_timeline_v1.xlsx (14 KB)]
[Attachment: MAP_action_items.pdf (9 KB)]

From: Ethan Ross <ethan.ross@ledgerpath.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: LedgerPath Trust Team <trust@ledgerpath.com>
Date: Tue, 12 May 2026 13:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Mutual Action Plan — security clarifications & timeline

Mina — thanks for the quick turnaround and the draft timeline. A few follow-ups from our legal/Security intake: 

- EU residency: this is a must for our PII; we can accept a VPC-hosted option (regional) for production, but the PoC can run on hosted if telemetry stays in-region for EU testers. Can you confirm whether hosted telemetry can be pinned to eu-west-1?

- SOC 2 scope: Security + Availability is fine, but our compliance team will want evidence mapping for confidentiality-related controls (encryption-in-transit, encryption-at-rest, access reviews). If you can annotate the SOC 2 controls or provide a control mapping that ties to CAIQ questions, that will expedite our review.

- DPA redlines: we prefer a 180-day maximum retention for certain identity-related artifacts; is there flexibility on that bucket for a carveout in the DPA? Also, we asked about data escrow/escrow-trigger conditions: what is Redwood's standard position?

- KMS: we'll need explicit confirmation that customer-managed keys can be used for production in the VPC product, and whether key rotation will break in-flight persisted KV caches or require special handling.

We'll confirm owners for evidence intake by EOD — likely SRE + Legal. If you can provide the CAIQ and a SOC2-control-mapping we can put together the SIG responses and lock the evidence intake date.

Best,
Ethan
Director, Platform & Security
LedgerPath

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 13 May 2026 08:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Mutual Action Plan — security clarifications & timeline

Team — quick internal note to align next steps and owners before we share CAIQ and SOC2 artifacts: 

Action items (owner / due):
- Legal redline review & DPA carveout assessment (Marissa) / due: 2026-05-18
- CAIQ export + control mapping (Marcus) / due: 2026-05-12 (we should have this already; push if needed)
- SOC2 evidence checklist (Ben) / due: 2026-05-14 -> attach CSV to the shared drive and grant LedgerPath read access
- KMS/HSM matrix & note on KV-cache behavior on key rotation (Infra Eng) / point: Marcus to coordinate with infra ops
- Confirm hosted telemetry regional pinning and VPC regional guarantees (Product Ops) / due: 2026-05-14

Escalation / gating notes:
- If LedgerPath requires EU residency for PII, we must treat production as Dedicated or VPC — mark that as a billing/contract variable and flag potential 8-10 week lead for Dedicated in eu-west.
- For the 180-day retention carveout: Legal to propose language that allows configurable retention per-data-class with a default of 365 days and customer-negotiable buckets; aim to avoid a blanket 180-day requirement without an exception path.

Please put final versions of CAIQ and SOC2 mapping into the Drive folder and add Ethan + trust@ledgerpath.com. I'll draft the internal exec note if Legal needs SLA exception signoff.

Ben Carter
Head of Sales Engineering, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: SOC2EvidenceChecklist.csv (4 KB)]
